notes.title: Release Date Announced + Steam Next Fest✨
notes.notes:
📣 We Have an Official Release Date 📣  
Mark your calendars because Love's Crescendo is going to be fully release on November 14th, 2023! This yuri romance story with rhythm mini games is about to launch soon, and just in time to cozy up for the winter weather.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43226035/3e2c9090cf7d55a04cb3b7003afcb0848f1e5128.png


✨ The LC DEMO is in the Steam Next Fest✨  

The Steam Next Fest is currently live, running from October 9th - October 16th. We're so excited to be featured, and what's even more exciting is that Steam showcased the LC gameplay in the OFFICIAL Steam Next Fest Trailer! See below:

[previewyoutube=zQLCg46Q8nY;full][/previewyoutube]
